body.name: Whole-fiber confidence region
body.construction: On the active branch set \(C_N=\bigcup_{J\in\mathcal J}[\beta_J(\widehat\Gamma_N)-2L_\beta\Delta_N,\beta_J(\widehat\Gamma_N)+2L_\beta\Delta_N]\cap[-\Lambda/\lambda,\Lambda/\lambda]\). On the fallback branch set \(C_N=[-\Lambda/\lambda,\Lambda/\lambda]\).
